items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well Savoy had a lot of old favorites. [INTERVIEWEE] They had played with them for years. They knew certain musicians, they had certain favorites you know.

ctx.x: I was in one night because I think I knew all this fellas. I think he took his regular six pieces I think he took to New York. He was six or maybe seven. I knew those fellas but right now I can't just call their names off. And he always had a nice band, six or seven pieces. I never heard this big band except I heard this guy here in New York, which wasn't his band, but the guys that they put in there.
Well Savoy had a lot of old favorites.
They had played with them for years. They knew certain musicians, they had certain favorites you know. Pick them in there. You've got to suit themselves most of the time.
